name: RelativeTime
description: "2 min ago", ticking on a shared clock; the absolute time is in a keyboard-accessible tooltip (R2.7).

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Tab order, for a list with roving focus. Default: focusable unless a control around it already is.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.
